name: VR Watch list and linker Lite
summary: VR Watch list and linker Lite is a MetaTrader 5 utility EA that provides a synchronized watch list and symbol linker functionality. It allows traders to manage and monitor multiple trading instruments from a single interface, linking chart symbol switching across multiple charts for streamlined multi-symbol analysis. The EA does not open any trades and serves purely as a chart management and navigation tool.
summary_zh: VR Watch list and linker Lite 是一款 MetaTrader 5 工具类EA，提供同步监控列表和品种链接功能。它允许交易者通过单一界面管理和监控多个交易品种，并在多个图表之间联动切换品种，实现高效的多品种分析。该EA不进行任何交易，纯粹作为图表管理和导航工具使用。
strategy_analysis: 该EA是一款纯工具类程序，不包含任何交易策略逻辑，因此没有入场条件、出场条件、仓位管理或资金管理的概念。其核心功能是提供一个可自定义的监控列表（Watch List），让交易者在一个面板上快速切换和查看多个品种的行情信息。链接功能（Linker）允许多个图表窗口同步切换品种，当用户在一个图表上切换品种时，其他已链接的图表会自动跟随切换到同一品种。此外，该工具可能支持一键排列图表、快速跳转到指定品种等便捷操作。整体而言，该EA的设计目的是提升交易者在多品种分析场景下的操作效率和工作流体验。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a pure utility program that contains no trading strategy logic whatsoever, so there are no entry conditions, exit conditions, position sizing, or money management concepts to analyze. Its core functionality is to provide a customizable watch list that allows traders to quickly switch and view market information for multiple symbols from a single panel. The linker feature enables multiple chart windows to synchronize symbol switching - when a user changes the symbol on one chart, all other linked charts automatically switch to the same symbol. Additionally, the tool may support one-click chart arrangement, quick navigation to a specified symbol, and other convenience features. Overall, the EA is designed to improve operational efficiency and workflow experience for traders working in multi-symbol analysis scenarios. It acts as a productivity enhancer rather than a trading decision-maker.

parameters.name: WatchListSymbols
parameters.description: 监控列表中的品种集合，可自定义添加或删除
parameters.description_en: Symbol set in watchlist, customizable add or remove

parameters.name: LinkerEnabled
parameters.description: 是否启用多图表品种联动切换功能

parameters.name: PanelPosition
parameters.description: 面板在图表上的显示位置（左上/右上/左下/右下）

parameters.name: ShowPrices
parameters.description: 是否在监控列表中显示实时价格信息
parameters.description_en: Show live price info in watchlist

parameters.name: AutoArrangeCharts
parameters.description: 是否自动排列已链接的图表窗口

pros: 提升多品种分析效率，一键切换和联动多个图表，显著减少手动操作时间
界面友好，提供可自定义的监控面板，交易者可根据个人需求配置品种列表和显示样式
作为工具类EA不执行任何交易操作，使用安全无风险，不会影响账户资金和持仓状态
链接功能实现了多图表协同工作，特别适合需要同时监控多个相关品种的交易者
Lite版本免费提供核心功能，降低了交易者的使用门槛
pros_en: Significantly improves multi-symbol analysis efficiency with one-click switching and synchronized chart linking, reducing manual operation time
User-friendly interface with a customizable watch panel where traders can configure symbol lists and display styles to personal preference
As a utility EA it executes no trades, making it completely safe to use without any risk to account balance or positions
The linker feature enables multi-chart collaboration, especially useful for traders monitoring multiple correlated instruments simultaneously
The Lite version provides core functionality for free, lowering the barrier to entry for traders
cons: 作为Lite版本，功能可能受限，高级特性需要购买完整版才能使用
不提供任何交易信号或策略辅助，对需要交易决策支持的交易者帮助有限
面板可能占用图表空间，在小屏幕或多图表布局中可能影响K线图的可见区域
品种联动切换在大量图表同时打开时可能出现延迟或卡顿现象
缺乏对自定义指标窗口的联动支持，仅限于主图表的品种切换
cons_en: As a Lite version, functionality may be limited with advanced features requiring purchase of the full version
Provides no trading signals or strategy assistance, offering limited help to traders needing decision support
The panel may occupy chart space and could obscure price data on small screens or in multi-chart layouts
Symbol linking may experience lag or stuttering when a large number of charts are open simultaneously
Lacks linking support for custom indicator sub-windows, limited to main chart symbol switching only
improvements: 增加键盘快捷键支持，进一步提升品种切换和图表管理的操作效率
添加价格报警功能，当监控列表中的品种价格触及预设水平时自动提醒交易者
支持更多面板自定义选项，如透明度调节、列排序、涨跌颜色标记等
improvements_en: Add keyboard shortcut support to further improve operational efficiency for symbol switching and chart management
Integrate price alert functionality to automatically notify traders when watched symbols reach preset price levels
Support more panel customization options such as transparency adjustment, column sorting, and color-coding for price changes

risk_points: 该EA为纯工具类程序，不执行任何交易操作，不存在资金风险
需注意面板界面可能遮挡图表信息，导致交易者遗漏重要价格变动
risk_points_en: This EA is a pure utility program that executes no trades, posing no financial risk whatsoever
Users should be aware that the panel interface may obscure chart information, potentially causing traders to miss important price movements
